title: American Goulash or Chop Suey
description: A hearty American Goulash recipe with ground beef, pasta, and flavorful seasonings.

ingredients.item: ground beef (beef pork blend or your choice)
A handful of fresh dried parsley

steps: Add ground beef to a large pot and cook until browned.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add minced garlic, paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, black pepper, cayenne pepper, and bay leaves. Stir and cook for a couple of minutes.
Pour in chicken broth, marinara sauce, diced tomatoes, water, and soy sauce. Stir to combine.
Add elbow macaroni noodles and bring to a rapid boil. Cook for 10 to 12 minutes until noodles are al dente.
Remove from heat, discard bay leaves, and stir in shredded cheddar cheese and parsley.
Cover and let sit for 5 minutes.
Serve in bowls, topped with additional cheddar cheese and parsley if desired.
